_comment_project_name: Optional label shown in the statusline (between open-tasks and MCP). Leave empty to fall back to the project folder name.
_comment_ai_providers: AI provider integration for multi-model analysis. Providers run as parallel Task agents (no MCP bridge). 6 per-phase flags gate participation: code_review, brainstorm, investigation, implementation, research_exploration, refactoring_planning. Available providers: codex (OpenAI Codex CLI), agy (Google Antigravity CLI). timeout is currently INERT — the wrappers enforce a fixed deadline (codex 300s, agy 330s watchdog) and do not read this key; it is kept for a future plumbing task. Legacy keys `include_in_architecture` and `include_in_exploration` are deprecated, and the retired `gemini` provider was replaced by `agy` — values are NOT auto-forwarded; session-start emits a one-time warning when they appear here.
_comment_agy: Google Antigravity CLI (agy) provider. Runs `agy --add-dir <project> --dangerously-skip-permissions --print-timeout 300s -p ...` (NO --sandbox — on macOS the sandbox blocks git and produces no review). skip-permissions gets past the headless soft-deny and is CONTAINED by a project-local `.agents/hooks.json` read-only deny-gate that team-management deploys automatically when agy is enabled (merge-aware); the wrapper also detects and reports any file mutations via a git-status check. Note: agy reads `.agents/hooks.json` for ANY agy invocation in this project, so your own manual `agy` runs here are also read-only-restricted (fails safe — more restrictive, never less). The framework does not override model selection — agy uses its CLI-default model (change via `agy --model <name>` or the agy /settings UI). Requires: Antigravity CLI installed and authenticated (run `agy` once to sign in).
_comment_read_only_bash_commands: Optional top-level array overriding which Bash commands are allowed in discussion mode (whole-word / prefix match, e.g. 'ls', 'git status', 'grep'). Omitted here so the built-in default allowlist (in sessions-enforce.py DEFAULT_CONFIG) applies; add the key only to customize. HAND-EDIT ONLY: this key is not settable via /team-management:config (it is absent from config_update's schema) — edit it directly in this file.
_comment_branch_prefixes: Task-prefix → branch-prefix mapping consulted by the branch-enforcement hook. Override here to customise; the engine falls back to the built-in defaults (defined in sessions-enforce.py DEFAULT_CONFIG) if `branch_enforcement.branch_prefixes` is omitted. The `o-` → `optimize/` mapping is required for the optimize / optimize-unattended protocols. The `b-` → `brainstorm/` mapping is required for the brainstorm protocol.
_comment_features: Icon styles: 'nerd_fonts' (default on macOS/Linux), 'emoji', 'ascii' (default on Windows)
_comment_code_review: enforce_warnings: When true, code review warnings must be acknowledged before task completion (default: false)
_comment_test_command: Optional. Command the code-review step runs to verify tests before advancing. Safe-by-design: must start with one of the allowlisted prefixes (pytest / npm test / cargo test / go test / rspec / rake test / python -m pytest / python -m unittest / python3 -m pytest / python3 -m unittest / jest) AND contain none of the forbidden shell metacharacters (; && || | ` $( > <). Runs with shell=False from the project root. Set to null to skip the gate.
_comment_notifications: Notifications: get alerted when protocols advance or AI needs your response. Channels: telegram. mode: 'per_step' pings on every protocol step (default); 'off' silences per-step pings but still delivers the protocol-completion ping. A missing 'mode' key defaults to 'per_step'. ca_bundle: optional path to a CA bundle (PEM) for verifying api.telegram.org — leave empty unless TLS verification fails (empty Python CA store or a TLS-inspecting proxy); env SSL_CERT_FILE / REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE are also honored.
_comment_auto_compact: Auto-compact: triggers context compaction protocol at threshold% token usage. context_limit: OPTIONAL explicit override of the model's context-window budget in tokens (e.g. 1000000 for 1M, 200000 for 200k). Leave null to auto-detect from the model name — a hardcoded value on a smaller model would make the threshold unreachable.
_comment_wiki: LLM Wiki: a persistent, compounding knowledge base Claude maintains under wiki/. Enable via /team-management:config (which also offers to seed wiki/). Default false.
_comment_provider_tokens: Provider API tokens are NOT stored in this file. They live in a per-project, user-authored .claude/state/provider-tokens.json (git-ignored, chmod 0600, keyed by provider name: gitlab/jira/github/telegram). Leave the api_token fields below empty; a token already present here from a legacy install still works as a fallback.
_comment_optimize_frontmatter: Optimize-protocol task frontmatter schema (engine-managed; do not edit by hand): optimize.best_commit, optimize.best_metric, optimize.baseline_commit, optimize.baseline_metric, optimize.baseline_wall_clock_s, optimize.runs_per_iteration, optimize.aggregator, optimize.experimentation_started_at. Written by `_func_capture_metric_baseline`, `_func_update_best_commit`, and `_handle_loop_iteration` in protocol_engine.py.
